description.narrative: The program supports government efforts to improve the employability of at-risk youth and facilitate young Filipinos' transition to the workforce by: (i) improving youth labor market programs; (ii) enhancing youth training systems; and (iii) strengthening labor market policies for the benefit of the youth.
